description: This file defines a PHP trait AwsClientTrait providing generic methods for interacting with AWS services, such as pagination, iteration, waiting for operations, and executing commands. It is used in classes implementing Aws	ag AwsClientInterface.

methods.name: getPaginator
methods.description: Returns a paginator object for a specific AWS operation, configured with given arguments.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the results of a paginated AWS operation, optionally using tokens for output/input.

methods.name: waitUntil
methods.description: Waits until a specified AWS resource reaches a desired state using a waiter.

methods.name: getWaiter
methods.description: Creates and returns a waiter object configured for a specific AWS resource.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method to handle calls to undefined methods, supports async variants and aliases.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a command object based on name and arguments.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the API service object.
